title: meet your controller
system_instruction_addendum: MEET CONTROLLER ADDENDUM: Name the rendered controller's three sections — left deck, mixer, right deck. Do not narrate features beyond the three sections.

tutor_speak.text: your controller has three big sections — left deck, mixer in the middle, right deck.
press the play button on the left deck when you've spotted it.

hints.text: the left deck is everything on the left third of your controller.
play sits in the bottom row of the deck — triangle glyph on a square button.
press play on the left deck now.
